name: Card Swap
description: A stack of 3D cards that changes with drag, click or autoplay: the front card jumps away, the rest shift with a five-axis spring, and a dimming halo builds depth.
interactionNotes: Drag the front card and release: the throw path determines the next card's entry direction and its tilt. Clicking the back cards brings them to the front, and the arrows/arrow keys switch too. On hover the stack opens slightly and the back cards look blurrier. The geometry is not mirrored: the stack opens up and to the right and dragging is finger physics; the keys are logical (right/down = next).

props.name: items
props.description: The cards; each has `title`, `image`, `icon` and `alt`. Without them, four sample cards appear.

props.name: children
props.description: Fully custom cards with `<Card>` — if you provide them, `items` is ignored.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of each card, pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of each card, pixels.

props.name: cardDistance
props.description: Horizontal spacing of the stack's steps.

props.name: verticalDistance
props.description: Vertical spacing of the steps — the cards step upward.

props.name: depth
props.description: Perspective depth of each step; back cards look smaller.

props.name: skewAmount
props.description: Skew of the stack in degrees; negative reverses its direction.

props.name: visibleCards
props.description: How many cards of the stack are visible.

props.name: delay
props.description: Autoplay interval, milliseconds.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Automatic advance of the front card.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause the playing on hover.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Dragging the front card to swap.

props.name: speed
props.description: Spring speed; 0.3 to 4.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Bounce of the front card when jumping; 0 to 1.

props.name: parallax
props.description: Layer separation with pointer movement; 0 to 1.

props.name: hoverSpread
props.description: How much the stack opens on hover; 0 to 0.4.

props.name: dim
props.description: Dimming of the back cards; 0 to 1.

props.name: cardRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards.

props.name: intro
props.description: Staggered entry of the cards on mount.

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette of the tile, border and dimming; it can also be changed with `--swap-*` variables.

props.name: onCardClick
props.description: A click on any card (even the back ones).

props.name: onChange
props.description: On every swap of the front card.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Extra class on the card container.

tips: The root fits itself into any box: `fit()` measures the container's width/height ratio and scales the whole stack — in a list card and bento it hosts with no configuration at all.
The drag path builds the next card's entry direction: drag from below so the next card comes in from below — the same feel as a real stack of paper.
Set `hoverSpread` to zero and raise `dim` for a quiet, deep stack; for a product showcase, a high `hoverSpread` and a negative `skewAmount` give a shelf feel.

The stack opens up and to the right — the default look and not mirrored; the title on the card sits in Persian and RTL. If you ever want the stack to open to the left, make the sign of `cardDistance` negative rather than mirroring the whole engine.
With `children` and `<Card>` you build any content; `onCardClick` is called even for the back cards.
